data.text: **Question:** Explain the ASP.NET Core pipeline in detail.
The pipeline consists of middleware components that process requests. Each can short-circuit or pass to next. Order is critical for correct behavior.

Request enters pipeline, passes through middleware in order. Each middleware can process before/after next. Endpoint middleware executes the final action. Exception handling should be early in pipeline.
